# GitHub Issue Templates

This directory contains issue templates to help teachers and staff submit well-structured change requests for the Mergington High School Activities website.

## Available Templates

### 🐛 Bug Report
Use this template to report problems with the website, such as:
- Incorrect colors or styling
- Broken features or functionality
- Missing content or elements
- Display issues

### ✨ Feature Request
Use this template to suggest new features or enhancements, such as:
- New functionality (dark mode, filtering, sorting)
- Improved user experience
- Additional capabilities for students or teachers

### 📝 Content Update
Use this template to request changes to text or information, such as:
- Updating activity descriptions
- Changing schedules or times
- Fixing outdated information
- Correcting text or labels

## How to Use

1. Click the "Issues" tab in the repository
2. Click "New Issue"
3. Select the appropriate template from the options
4. Fill out all required fields with clear, detailed information
5. Submit the issue

## Template Benefits

These templates ensure that:
- All necessary information is provided upfront
- GitHub Copilot can better understand and assist with the request
- Issues are organized and easy to track
- Non-technical staff can submit clear, actionable requests

## Configuration

The templates are configured in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` to:
- Disable blank issues (requiring template selection)
- Provide helpful links to documentation
